deliveryRules: This is a verified producer contract handoff, not a source-write instruction.
FRONTEND first-intake and synthetic API work require a separately released clean writer slot; the current frontend worktree has preserved N03 callback WIP.
CCC-290 additionally requires CCC-289. DESIGN CCC-288 retains the DESIGN worktree ownership lock and follows the design lane.
No consumer may add an envelope-2 alias, infer question identity from text/order, or claim compatibility before its actual tests and browser checks pass.
All execution questions and results return only to relayer-orchestrator.
